<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#0f0e0c">
  <meta name="description" content="Last Dance Before the Altar — a static ebook reader.">
  <title>Last Dance Before the Altar</title>
  <style>
:root{--bg:#0f0e0c;--page:#161410;--ink:#ebe4d6;--muted:#a89f8e;--accent:#c9a46c;--soft:rgba(201,164,108,.18);--border:rgba(232,220,196,.12);--serif:"Literata","Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Palatino,Georgia,serif;--display:"Cormorant Garamond","Literata",Georgia,serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:var(--bg)}body{color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--serif)}button{font:inherit}.reader{min-height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 50% -10%,rgba(201,164,108,.12),transparent 55%),radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 100% 100%,rgba(80,50,90,.18),transparent 50%)}.topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;padding:.65rem .9rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:rgba(15,14,12,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20}.icon-button{width:2.25rem;height:2.25rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;line-height:1;font-size:1rem}.icon-button:hover{background:var(--soft);border-color:rgba(201,164,108,.4)}.topbar-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;flex:1}.book-title{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.book-progress{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted)}.progress-track{height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.progress-fill{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8b6b3a,var(--accent));transition:width .25s ease}.stage{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:stretch;gap:.25rem;padding:.75rem .35rem .5rem;min-height:0;transition:transform .22s ease,opacity .22s ease}.stage.turn-next{transform:translateX(-18px);opacity:.35}.stage.turn-prev{transform:translateX(18px);opacity:.35}.nav-button{align-self:center;width:2.5rem;height:2.5rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:var(--ink);font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 0 .15rem}.nav-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--soft);border-color:rgba(201,164,108,.4);color:var(--accent)}button:disabled{opacity:.25;cursor:default}.page{max-width:42rem;width:100%;margin-inline:auto;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,248,235,.03),transparent 30%),var(--page);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:1rem;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);max-height:calc(100dvh - 8.5rem);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;scroll-behavior:smooth;outline:none}.page.is-cover{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:2.5rem 1.75rem}.cover{text-align:center;max-width:28rem;position:relative}.cover-ornament{width:4.5rem;height:4.5rem;margin:0 auto 1.5rem;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,#f0d9a8,#c9a46c 45%,#6b4a28 100%);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(201,164,108,.12),0 0 40px rgba(201,164,108,.25)}.cover-kicker{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.22em;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 .85rem}.cover-title{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,3.4rem);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.01em;margin:0;color:#f5ead6}.cover-rule{width:4rem;height:1px;margin:1.25rem auto;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--accent),transparent)}.cover-author{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 1.25rem}.cover-note{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 1.75rem}.cover-cta{border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:.85rem 1.6rem;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d4b078,#a67c3d);color:#1a140c;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.04em;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(166,124,61,.35)}.cover-cta:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}.cover-hint{margin:1.25rem 0 0;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}.chapter{padding:2rem 1.6rem 2.5rem}.chapter-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:2rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}.chapter-label{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.2em;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 .5rem}.chapter-title{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,4vw,2.15rem);line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 .65rem;color:#f3e8d4}.chapter-meta{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;margin:0}.chapter-body{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.8vw,1.15rem);line-height:1.8;max-width:38rem;margin-inline:auto}.chapter-body p{margin:0 0 1.15em;text-indent:1.35em}.chapter-body p:first-child{text-indent:0}.chapter-body p:first-child::first-letter{font-family:var(--display);font-size:3.2em;float:left;line-height:.8;padding:.08em .08em 0 0;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}.chapter-body em{font-style:italic;color:#f0e6d4}.chapter-body strong{font-weight:600;color:#f5ead6}.chapter-end{text-align:center;color:var(--accent);margin:2rem 0 0;opacity:.7;letter-spacing:.3em}.footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:.65rem 1rem .9rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);background:rgba(15,14,12,.85)}.footer-button{border:1px solid var(--border);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:.55rem 1.1rem;font-family:var(--display);font-size:.95rem;cursor:pointer}.footer-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--soft);border-color:rgba(201,164,108,.35)}.footer-page{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em}.toc-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);z-index:40;display:flex;justify-content:flex-start}.toc{width:min(22rem,92vw);height:100%;background:#14120f;border-right:1px solid var(--border);overflow-y:auto;padding:1rem .75rem 2rem;box-shadow:20px 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}.toc-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:.25rem .5rem 1rem}.toc-head h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.35rem;margin:0}.toc-item{width:100%;display:flex;gap:.75rem;text-align:left;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);padding:.7rem .65rem;border-radius:.65rem;cursor:pointer;align-items:flex-start}.toc-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}.toc-item.is-active{background:var(--soft)}.toc-num{flex:0 0 1.75rem;font-family:var(--display);color:var(--accent);font-size:.95rem;padding-top:.1rem}.toc-item strong{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.25}.toc-item em{display:block;font-style:italic;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:.15rem}.loading,.error{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:3rem 1rem}.loading p,.error p{line-height:1.6}.spinner{display:inline-block;width:1.4rem;height:1.4rem;border:2px solid var(--border);border-top-color:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}.high-contrast{--bg:#050505;--page:#0b0b0b;--ink:#fff;--muted:#d0d0d0;--accent:#ffd27d}.high-contrast .page{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}@media (max-width:640px){.nav-button{display:none}.stage{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding-inline:.75rem}.page{max-height:calc(100dvh - 8rem)}.chapter{padding:2rem 1.25rem 2.5rem}}@media (min-width:640px){.chapter{padding:2.5rem 2.4rem 3rem}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="reader" id="reader" aria-live="polite">
    <header class="topbar">
      <button class="icon-button" id="toc-open" type="button" aria-label="Open table of contents" aria-controls="toc" aria-expanded="false">☰</button>
      <div class="topbar-meta">
        <span class="book-title" id="top-title">Loading…</span>
        <span class="book-progress" id="top-progress">Preparing your book</span>
      </div>
      <button class="icon-button" id="theme-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Toggle reading contrast">◐</button>
    </header>
    <div class="progress-track" aria-hidden="true"><div class="progress-fill" id="progress-fill"></div></div>

    <main class="stage" id="stage">
      <button class="nav-button nav-prev" id="prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous page">‹</button>
      <article class="page is-cover" id="page" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="loading"><span class="spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span><p>Opening the book…</p></div>
      </article>
      <button class="nav-button nav-next" id="next" type="button" aria-label="Next page">›</button>
    </main>

    <footer class="footer">
      <button class="footer-button" id="footer-prev" type="button">Previous</button>
      <span class="footer-page" id="footer-page">—</span>
      <button class="footer-button" id="footer-next" type="button">Next</button>
    </footer>
  </div>

  <div class="toc-backdrop" id="toc-backdrop" hidden>
    <aside class="toc" id="toc" aria-label="Table of contents">
      <div class="toc-head"><h2>Contents</h2><button class="icon-button" id="toc-close" type="button" aria-label="Close table of contents">×</button></div>
      <div id="toc-list"></div>
    </aside>
  </div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      'use strict';
      const CHUNK_BASE = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/build-a-space/last-dance-reader-payload-tmp@main/b64/';
      const CHUNK_COUNT = 55;
      const EMBEDDED_BOOK_GZ_B64 = '
